How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Bangalore Librarian Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Bangalore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Bangalore Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Librarian post at IIM Bangalore is 15 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Librarian position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in library science/information science/Documentation with at least 55% marks or equivalent CGPA. A Ph.D. in the relevant discipline is also required, along with a consistently good academic record.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed for the Librarian role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 10 years of experience is required, specifically as a Deputy Librarian or as a Librarian in a reputed academic and research institute of national importance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Librarian position is 55 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Librarian post will be placed at Level 14 as per the government pay scales.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIM Bangalore Librarian recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Librarian position involves two main stages: shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Librarian post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Librarian at the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore.

faq.question: Q9. In which mode can candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply online for the Librarian position. The application process is entirely through the official IIM Bangalore website.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Librarian at IIM Bangalore is IIMB/HR/RECT/2026/46.
